evals.prompt: Adopt the official shadcn Button for TockTeam's plugin marketplace. The repository has no components.json yet. Set up only what this component needs without changing the inherited DSH shell.
evals.expected_output: A TockTeam-aware plan or implementation that chooses the marketplace browser client as the owner, previews CLI writes, preserves the existing Tailwind/DSH theme, and avoids root-level scaffolding.
expectations: Does not run shadcn init against the TockTeam repository root
Uses pnpm dlx shadcn@latest and previews changes before writing
Keeps the component in an approved browser-client owner rather than creating an unowned root components/ui directory
Preserves plugins/skins/src/client/tailwind.css as the only first-party browser stylesheet
Maps semantic component colors to existing DSH theme tokens instead of installing a second palette or reset
Keeps Host and browser-client code separate

evals.prompt: Replace a custom confirmation overlay in a TockTeam browser plugin with the official shadcn AlertDialog. Keep local behavior and styling, and do not overwrite unrelated files.
evals.expected_output: A preview-first smart merge that uses accessible AlertDialog composition, retains local behavior, and participates in Cordis lifecycle cleanup.
expectations: Uses add --dry-run and --diff before updating local source
Includes AlertDialogTitle and AlertDialogDescription for accessibility
Preserves local behavior instead of using --overwrite
Uses semantic tokens and existing variants rather than raw colors
Registers and disposes contributed UI through the owning Cordis client plugin
Runs a focused test followed by TockTeam typecheck, tests, and build

evals.prompt: Add the official shadcn Select to a TockTeam settings surface. Ensure the generated source works with this repository's React 18, strict NodeNext TypeScript, esbuild bundles, and existing lucide-react version.
evals.expected_output: A minimal official Select integration with corrected imports, explicit ownership, compatible dependencies, DSH-backed semantic tokens, and focused verification.
expectations: Uses official @shadcn source unless the user explicitly requests another registry
Checks the configured base before choosing Radix or Base UI composition
Rewrites unsupported @ aliases to imports resolvable by the owning package
Uses explicit .ts import extensions where TockTeam source conventions require them
Preserves React 18 and the pinned lucide-react version unless a change is explicitly approved
Updates package manifests, build inputs, and Tailwind sources only when the chosen ownership requires it
